819:t_1:3.en: ～ Inside the Imperial Capital, $$ラース・バビロン$$ ～

819:t_1:4.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「...It appears we were still underestimating the Earth species.」

819:t_1:5.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Hold on, $$アウストラリス$$. This time was just a string of coincidences.」

819:t_1:6.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Who could have imagined a $$時空震動弾$$ would distort causality and reach the $$黒い太陽#sol$$?」

819:t_1:7.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「That is what it means to underestimate them.」

819:t_1:8.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「They have four $$スフィア$$s, too. And that includes the $$いがみ合う双子$$.」

819:t_1:9.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「They also possess a power unknown even to us. It made contact with the $$黒い太陽#sol$$.」

819:t_1:11.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「You're awfully angry, $$バルビエル$$.」

819:t_1:12.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Shut up, you half-baked amateur...」

819:t_1:13.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「You say that, but you haven't managed to steal a single $$スフィア$$ yourself.」

819:t_1:14.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「Hurry up and beat everyone except $$ジェミニオン$$, and absorb the other three $$スフィア$$s.」

819:t_1:15.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「You can't blame $$バルビエル$$ for that. We... can't steal $$スフィア$$s by defeating other Reactors.」

819:t_1:18.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「So we have two choices: win them over, or beat them into submission.」

819:t_1:19.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「But I'm done with that...!」

819:t_1:20.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「$$バルビエル$$...」

819:t_1:21.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「I can't stand their very existence anymore.」

819:t_1:22.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「If they die and the $$スフィア$$s transfer to another world, I'll go after them...! So let me kill those bastards!」

819:t_1:24.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Are you serious, $$アウストラリス$$?」

819:t_1:25.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「First, they must return to this world.」

819:t_1:27.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「Let me finish that for you, Your Majesty.」

819:t_1:28.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「$$バルビエル$$... If you think you can beat them, go ahead and try.」

819:t_1:30.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「Things seem to be heating up in the Empire, so I'll make my move, too.」

819:t_1:31.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「I can't wait for the day you fight my $$ジェミニオン$$, $$バルビエル$$.」

819:t_1:32.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「When that day comes, I'll show you... who deserves that love and favor.」

819:t_1:33.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「...All of this depends on them returning.」

819:t_1:34.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「$c... Beyond time and space, you will learn how terrifying $$サイデリアル$$ truly is.」

819:t_10:4.en:
$$高性能ＡＩ$$
「Welcome. The situation is unclear, but $$Ｄトレーダー$$ will remain open for business.」

819:t_10:5.en:
$$高性能ＡＩ$$
「Please understand that our congratulations to ace pilots will have to wait for another occasion.」

819:t_10:6.en:
$$高性能ＡＩ$$
「Now, everyone, please take your time and enjoy your shopping.」

820:t_000:0.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「This space... It's just like when we were thrown into the galactic core...!」

820:t_000:1.en:
$$ブライト$$
「At this rate, we'll be sent into the galaxy again...!?」

820:t_000:4.en:
$$カヲル$$
「This is the space between cause and effect... A horizon called possibility.」

820:t_000:5.en:
$$シンジ$$
「$$カヲル$$... What are you...」

820:t_000:6.en:
$$カヲル$$
「Our wishes, within that distorted causality, came into contact with a great power. And that gives rise to power.」

820:t_001:4.en:
$$カヲル$$
「They're now bound by the chains of causality, between cause and effect. All that remains is...」

820:t_001:5.en:
$n
「$$シンジ$$, Colonel $$シャア$$, $$クロウ$$...! If this keeps up...!」

820:t_001:6.en:
$n
「Go to $$シンジ$$.」
「Go to $$クロウ$$.」
「Go to $$シャア$$.」

820:t_003:0.en:
$$カヲル$$
「I see... So that's how it will be.」

820:t_006:1.en:
$$シャア$$
「Stay back, $n! Something... is distorted here!」

825:t_10:4.en:
$$高性能ＡＩ$$
「Welcome. The situation is unclear, but $$Ｄトレーダー$$ will remain open for business.」

825:t_10:5.en:
$$高性能ＡＩ$$
「Please understand that our congratulations to ace pilots will have to wait for another occasion.」

825:t_10:6.en:
$$高性能ＡＩ$$
「Now, everyone, please take your time and enjoy your shopping.」
